name: Mobilerun (formerly Droidrun)
description: Open-source framework and cloud for AI agents that control real Android and iOS phones: run tasks, tap and type in apps, read screens, via hosted MCP, CLI, SDKs and REST API.

skills.name: Control an Android Phone
skills.description: Tap, type, install apps, upload files and read the UI state or screenshots of a real or cloud Android device.

skills.name: Run Cloud Phones
skills.description: Create and terminate hosted Cloud Android and Cloud iOS phones, or connect your own Android or iPhone to the cloud.

skills.name: Run Mobile Agent Tasks
skills.description: Send a natural-language goal to the Mobilerun agent, monitor task status and screenshots, and get structured output.

skills.name: Read SMS and Email Codes
skills.description: Provision phone numbers and mailboxes and read SMS conversations and email verification codes during sign-up flows.

skills.name: Tunnel ADB to Cloud Devices
skills.description: Run local adb or Frida, or Puppeteer and Playwright over CDP, against a Mobilerun cloud device through a WebSocket tunnel.
